readout.title: How coordination slowed (the four mechanisms of the Waltzman paper)
readout.summary: Community, legal, logistics, and technical groups raised local concerns through separate routes to different countries, and unresolved or reopened concerns repeatedly slowed the partnership’s activation process. The countries eventually authorized and deployed the system, but operating reviews reopened resolved concerns; conditional support then suspended deployment, which resumed after concerns were remedied and support restored.

readout_text:
What happened: How coordination slowed (the four mechanisms of the Waltzman paper)

Community, legal, logistics, and technical groups raised local concerns through separate routes to different countries, and unresolved or reopened concerns repeatedly slowed the partnership’s activation process. The countries eventually authorized and deployed the system, but operating reviews reopened resolved concerns; conditional support then suspended deployment, which resumed after concerns were remedied and support restored.

Happened: Local concerns through separate channels
Community, Legal, Logistics, and Technical groups each sent a distinct local concern through its own route to Country D, Country B, Country C, and Country A. The countries therefore received different concerns.
